component.name: grawji
component.summary: Develop Fujifilm RAFs through the real camera engine

description.p: grawji is a GTK4 frontend for rawji. It develops Fujifilm RAF files on Linux using the camera's own conversion engine over USB, so the result is identical to Fujifilm X RAW Studio: authentic film simulations and recipes, rendered by the body itself.

ul.li: Live preview through the camera's own conversion engine
Full recipe control: film simulation, white balance, dynamic range, tone, colour, sharpness, grain, noise reduction, clarity, Color Chrome and monochromatic colour toning
Save, apply and import/export recipes in X RAW Studio's FP format, with a try-them-all comparison grid and duplicate detection
Crop and straighten with automatic horizon detection
Write recipes into the camera's custom banks and FS dial, and back up and restore camera settings over USB
Browse, filter and cull RAFs in the filmstrip
Single and full-folder batch export at full resolution

screenshot.caption: Tuning a recipe with a live preview from the camera

description.p: A large update that adds in-app editing, camera-side recipe features and new preview tools.

ul.li: Crop and straighten images, with automatic horizon detection to level a tilted shot in one click
Per-image exposure and crop are saved next to each RAF and restored the next time you open it
Try several recipes side by side in a comparison grid, each rendered by the camera
Give saved recipes a thumbnail and a comment in the recipe manager, and spot duplicate recipes automatically
Paste community recipes straight from the clipboard
Write recipes into the camera's C1 to C7 custom banks and the FS dial over USB
Back up the camera's settings to a file and restore them later over USB
Filter the filmstrip by camera metadata and cull directly from it by copying, moving or trashing RAFs
A clipping overlay marks blown highlights and crushed shadows directly on the preview
Dynamic range now includes Auto and is limited to what the shot itself supports
